title: imap build_credential_store erases error type to String at point of use
description: reader/server_stores.rs uses a typed BuildStoreError enum (thiserror, two variants) before converting to String at the startup boundary. imap/main.rs converts CredentialStoreError to String inline via .map_err(|e| e.to_string()) inside the fn body, with no intermediate typed enum. When a new error class is added (e.g. a secrets-manager timeout vs a parse error), imap loses the ability to handle them differently. The divergence also means a maintainer updating reader's pattern has no signal that imap needs the same update. Scenario: a new BuildStoreError::Timeout variant is added to reader for retry logic; imap silently conflates it with parse errors.
